'''Mieczysław Jan Warmus''' (born 1 June 1918 in Dobrowlany, Poland (now [[:be:Дабраўляны (Смаргонскі раён)|Дабраўляны]], [[:be:Беларусь|Беларусь]]); died 20 September 2007 in [[Wollongong]], [[Australia]]).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Biogram - Biblioteka Jagiellońska - Uniwersytet Jagielloński |url=https://bj.uj.edu.pl/zasoby-cyfrowe/baza-biogramow/biogram?id=32091 |access-date=2025-02-20 |website=bj.uj.edu.pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Krzyśko |first=Mirosław |title=Prof. Mieczysław Warmus (1918 – 2007) |url=https://www2.ibspan.waw.pl/komisja.statystyki/wspomnienia/Warmus.pdf |publisher=Komitet Matematyki PAN|lang=pl}}</ref> He was a [[Polish mathematician]], a pioneer of [[computer science]] in Poland,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Warmus |first=Mieczysław |date=2024-12-12 |title=Komisja Statystyki Komitetu Matematyki PAN |url=https://www2.ibspan.waw.pl/komisja.statystyki/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://www2.ibspan.waw.pl/komisja.statystyki/wspomnienia/Warmus.pdf |archive-date=2024-12-12 |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=IBS PAN}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite book |last=Krzyśko |first=Mirosław |url=https://stat.gov.pl/download/gfx/portalinformacyjny/pl/defaultaktualnosci/5501/31/1/1/statystycy_polscy_biogramy.pdf |title=Statystycy polscy. Biogramy. Mieczysław Jan Warmus (1918–2007) |date=2018 |publisher=Zakład Wydawnictw Statystycznych. Wykaz doktoratów za lata 1945-2015 |work=Poz. 1109 Mieczysław Warmus. Temat rozprawy: O obliczaniu pól obszarów płaskich przy pomocy siatek równoległobokowych . Archiwum |language=pl |quote=Archiv no. 34/611}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Mieczysław Warmus - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=330430 |access-date=2025-04-14 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref> The habilitation thesis titled ''"Nomogrammable Functions"'' was defended on February 22, 1958.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Instytut Matematyczny Polskiej Akademii Nauk - Doktoraty |url=https://www.impan.pl/pl/awanse/doktoraty |access-date=2025-02-22 |website=www.impan.pl}}</ref> By a resolution dated May 29, 1958, the Central Qualification Committee for Scientific Workers awarded Associate Professor Dr. habil. Mieczysław Warmus the academic title of ''Extraordinary Professor''.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

Warmus died on September 20, 2007, in [[Wollongong]], [[Australia]]. He was buried on October 2, 2007, at the [[Powązki Cemetery]] in [[Warsaw]].
